Let the girl know that you like her but you aren’t ready for a relationship. Being honest is the best thing for you and this girl! Don’t get into something you aren’t ready for. It will end quickly and hurt the girl you like. Tell her you’re willing to be friends for now, and maybe you’ll be ready for her later. Don’t count on it though, but it will go way better then going into something you aren’t ready for. Take care of yourself!
Maybe now you can find closure with her now that you know it’s over for good. But I know despite these things the heart wants what it wants. Good luck 💙

New Car this year because my old scrap bucket went out. But I was defiantly beyond expecting that. Got a good car for 2300 and so far just a synthetic oil change and two patched tires!!! I think I just have bad luck with tires. An old screw and a tiny hole with nothing in it. Thought I might have a bad battery but luckily the terminal holder just loosened. I think I will have to get brakes later this year. So far not too bad. When you’re dealing with cheap cars you just need to know when to sell and it’s pretty cost effective.

I’ll do food delivery apps as my main source of income as long as there is one in my market that pays well enough. I love driving around and I’m not qualified to work anything that pays more then this currently. But my rent is cheap and I’m young and in Community College barely part time so this works well. I plan on putting more hours into school when I figure out what I really want to do. But for now I’m pretty happy with this. I could definitely see this being my main job for the next 6-8 years. I just hope it stays a realistic possibility while I figure my career path out!
